title: PromptSense: Sentiment-Aware Mental Health Chatbot with Dynamic Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2610.38044v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current Large Language Models (LLMs)-based mental health chatbots often lack sufficient empathy, contextual awareness, and safety mechanisms, potentially leading to ineffective or harmful interactions. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates sentiment and depression analysis with a rule-based filtering mechanism prior to model inference. By dynamically constructing prompts based on emotional and risk-related insights, the framework aims to significantly improve the contextual relevance, empathy, and risk-aware of model-generated responses. We evaluated four model strategies and two prompt engineered variants across qualitative metrics such as empathy, helpfulness, clarity, relevance, safety, as well as toxicity assessments using the Perspective API. Experimental results indicate that the prompt engineering approaches outperforms DSFT and RLAIF by 1.8\% and 1.1\% respectively.

translated_title: PromptSense：具有动态提示的情感感知心理健康聊天机器人
translated_abstract: 当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的心理健康聊天机器人通常缺乏足够的共情能力、上下文感知和安全机制，可能导致无效甚至有害的交互。本文提出了一种新颖的框架，在模型推理之前将情感与抑郁分析和基于规则的过滤机制相结合。通过基于情感和风险相关的洞察动态构建提示，该框架旨在显著提高模型生成回复的上下文相关性、共情能力和风险感知水平。我们评估了四种模型策略和两种提示工程变体，评估指标包括共情性、有用性、清晰度、相关性、安全性等定性指标，以及使用Perspective API进行的毒性评估。实验结果表明，提示工程方法分别比DSFT和RLAIF高出1.8%和1.1%。
tldr: 该论文提出PromptSense框架，通过在模型推理前整合情感与抑郁分析及规则过滤机制来动态构建提示，显著提升了心理健康聊天机器人回复的共情性、相关性和安全性，且提示工程方法优于DSFT和RLAIF。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PromptSense, a framework that integrates sentiment and depression analysis with rule-based filtering to dynamically construct prompts, significantly improving the empathy, relevance, and safety of mental health chatbot responses, with prompt engineering outperforming DSFT and RLAIF.
